cases.name: resource-absent-from-application
cases.description: A resource the revision introduces but the live tree does not carry. ArgoCD fails the lookup with codes.InvalidArgument (3), which the gRPC gateway renders as HTTP 400 — not 404 — so the message is the only signal that this means absent.

body.error: Job batch argocd-contract-probe-absent-job not found as part of application argocd
body.message: Job batch argocd-contract-probe-absent-job not found as part of application argocd

cases.name: resource-absent-core-group
cases.description: The same absence for a core-group resource. The empty group leaves a double space in the message, which is exactly the detail a hand-written fake gets wrong.

body.error: ConfigMap  argocd-contract-probe-absent-configmap not found as part of application argocd
body.message: ConfigMap  argocd-contract-probe-absent-configmap not found as part of application argocd

cases.name: resource-unknown-application
cases.description: An unknown Application. ArgoCD resolves RBAC through the project it cannot look up for a name that does not exist, so this is a permission denial and must never be read as absence.

cases.name: resource-malformed-query
cases.description: A request missing the required resourceName. Answered 5xx, so a broad '400 means absent' shortcut would not swallow it — but a broad 'non-200 means absent' one would.

body.error: grpc: error while marshaling: proto: required field "resourceName" not set
body.message: grpc: error while marshaling: proto: required field "resourceName" not set

cases.name: application-unknown-with-project
cases.description: An unknown Application read through getApplication WITH a project. The project narrows the RBAC lookup, so this is the one place ArgoCD does answer a clean 404 — which is why delete-application's wait loop can rely on it.

cases.name: application-unknown-without-project
cases.description: The same read without a project. getApplication does not send one, so a missing Application surfaces as a permission denial rather than a 404 — the reason its error mentions the possibility.
